text.content:
Built the first CitiNet. Gone now.

Industry: Networks (defunct)
Status: Shut down by Netwatch in the 2050s; its files are classified

A Night City corporation that built the first CitiNet in 2030, a smaller, local version of the Old Net running on the old public dataterm lines. The idea spread to cities worldwide.

The CitiNets turned out to be less sealed off from the Old Net than Ziggurat promised. In the 2050s Netwatch shut Ziggurat down, took over the CitiNets and classified everything the company had.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.12
